adultDescription: Has crossed more ground than anything else here, and could not draw you a map of a single step of it.
babyDescription: Goes wherever it is put. It has not yet noticed that it is moving.
description: Sendling has been everywhere and remembers nowhere. It rides whatever happens to be moving and is set down somewhere new before it has finished looking at the last place. It is not lost, exactly. It has simply never been anywhere long enough for the word to apply.

history.change: dex-edit: baseColor #3FC9D6 -> #17BCCB, clearing glitchfin at dE00 0.7 and puddlejack at 1.3 ACROSS THE HUE SWEEP. This is W64-ROSTER group C, not the canonical-colour bar: a species swept over its whole plus-or-minus 30 degree hue range must stay a just-noticeable difference away from every OTHER species at rest, or a mutated Pal reads as a different species. A single sample at 0 degrees cannot see this and did not — the canonical measurement passed all three of these before the gate was extended to cover pack species at all.

name: Sendling
teenDescription: Has learned it can pick which way to go, and picks all of them.
